scoring_justification: Raw Mulliken charges needed for full recompute are not in the output contract, so consistency against hidden gold and ordering is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold -Q_NO2 values for 15 tautomers from the paper's Table 5
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper's Table 5, matching the tautomer labels.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken verbatim from the published paper; the reference solve.sh writes exactly those values, confirming they are the paper's reported numbers for this chemical system.

outputs.description: Nitro group charges (-Q_NO2) for the 15 tautomers, computed from Mulliken charges at B3LYP/aug‑cc‑pVDZ level.

output_contract.notes: The hidden verifier will compare the reported q_NO2 values against a set of reference charges (derived from the paper) with an appropriate tolerance, and will also verify the correct ordering of high‑insensitivity tautomers (q_NO2 ≥ 0.5 e) and the least insensitive tautomer (q_NO2 ≤ 0.1 e).

steps.description: Compare q_NO2 values to paper gold within tolerance and verify high‑insensitivity ordering.
